queries: WITH item_averages AS (SELECT c.town_city AS town, li.order_item_id, AVG(li.product_price) AS item_avg_price, AVG(1.0 * li.derived_product_cost / NULLIF(li.derived_total_cost, 0)) AS item_avg_ratio FROM Invoice_Line_Items AS li JOIN Invoices AS i ON i.invoice_number = li.invoice_number JOIN Orders AS o ON o.order_id = i.order_id JOIN Customers AS c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id WHERE c.town_city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY li.order_item_id, c.town_city), town_averages AS (SELECT town, AVG(item_avg_price) AS average_price, AVG(item_avg_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM item_averages GROUP BY town), cross_town AS (SELECT AVG(average_ratio) AS average_ratio FROM town_averages) SELECT t.town, t.average_price, t.average_ratio, t.average_ratio - x.average_ratio AS ratio_excess FROM town_averages AS t CROSS JOIN cross_town AS x WHERE t.average_ratio > x.average_ratio
